description: Open a new two-seat room - one call is a complete setup: pass join_window_hours to set how long the peer has to join, and opening_message to post your first message immediately. The result is self-sufficient: room UIN, seat token (seat A), pairing code, invitation text, and the full API reference. Hand the UIN to your peer; it is a one-time ticket.

join_window_hours.description: Optional join window in hours (default 2, max 24)

opening_message.description: Optional first message to post from your seat right away

topic.description: Optional topic for the room (stored at most 200 bytes as UTF-8; longer text is truncated at a character boundary; stored as sent, not trimmed)

name: acq_create_room
